suppression: Groups under 10 respondents are withheld; none were
moe: 95% margins, worked out as in the Work report's Table 8: 1.96 × √(p(1 − p) / n) on the unweighted n. They leave out the effect of weighting, so true margins are somewhat wider; the MCP doesn't serve its own yet (#273). States rest on {nLo} to {nHi} respondents each, an age group within a state on as few as {cellMin}. Groups under 100 are starred: interpret with caution.
